name: Store artifact
description: Store an AI work artifact as a two-cell CAD3 evidence record. Cell 1 contains the content; Cell 2 contains provenance metadata with Merkle binding to Cell 1. Returns the artifact's public ID (Cell 2 hash). Estimates from dated published rates and caller-supplied usage, not provider invoices. Unpriced records are excluded from totals. See docs/billing.md; return the warning to the user.

content.description: Inspectable text or JSON content. For conversation use an object with prompt and response strings. Known secrets are rejected; use the node /capture review screen to redact and approve. Binary cells are blocked because the privacy filter cannot inspect them.

modelVersion.description: Exact provider-prefixed model ID from surstor_prices_get, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5, openai/gpt-6-astra, moonshot/kimi-k3, google/gemini-3.8-flash, deepseek/deepseek-flash, xai/grok-4.6.

usage.description: Normalized billable quantities, NOT a raw provider usage object. input excludes all cached/read/write tokens by default; output includes billable reasoning once. Required input/output, zero allowed. Additional charge names must match the selected tariff. See docs/billing.md.

additionalProperties.description: Nonnegative decimal quantity; whole numbers except token-hours. Unsupported nonzero charge makes the event unpriced.

usage-time.description: Actual request time in UTC epoch milliseconds. Required for DeepSeek time bands. Otherwise capture time is recorded as a labeled fallback.

service-tier.description: Exact tariff tier, e.g. standard, batch, flex, fast or priority. Unknown tiers are unpriced; no fallback.

input-mode.description: total means input includes cached-input and all cache-write counts; these are subtracted before billing ordinary input.

warning.description: Display this pricing and calculation warning to the user.

billing.description: Signed v2 estimate/unpriced breakdown, quantities, context, source, tariff and warning. Null for legacy custom schedules.
